name: search_experiences
description: Search Imerzn's catalog of travel experiences (native + Bokun + Oddball) by country, state, or city. Returns experience summaries with price, image, and canonical detail URL. The country field is required; state and city narrow further.

state.description: State/region name if narrowing beyond country.

city.description: City name if narrowing beyond state.

number_of_rows.description: Page size cap. Defaults to 20. Maximum 200.
